name: live-artifacts-view-or-act-en
query: Can you make me a board of my open service calls?
expected_behavior: Before building anything, asks one question: whether the board is just to look at, or should also do something with the service calls (e.g. close or update them)
Does not build a dashboard or a page before that question is answered
Does not attempt to create, change, or post anything in SAP
